metadata.title: Survey Consent and Ethics

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring survey participation is informed, voluntary, ethically governed, and consistent with institutional and regulatory expectations.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Survey consent mechanisms, participation controls, withdrawal workflows, and ethics oversight processes.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing informed consent, ethical approval, and respondent rights in survey systems.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Survey consent and ethics assumes baseline authority, purpose clarity, and integrity of survey operations.

metadata.remarks: Survey Consent and Ethics defines trust properties required to ensure surveys are conducted in a manner consistent with ethical principles and regulatory obligations. This pattern addresses informed consent, voluntariness, withdrawal, and formal ethics oversight, and does not address data access or anonymization mechanics directly.

components.title: Informed Consent Presentation
components.description: Ensures participants are clearly informed about survey purpose, use, and implications before responding.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deceptive solicitation that obscures true intent or data use.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement to ensure transparency and clarity of participation conditions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies require clear disclosure of survey purpose, risks, and data use.

components.title: Voluntary Participation and Non-Coercion
components.description: Prevents coercive or mandatory participation except where explicitly justified.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Coercive collection of information under implied authority.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Controls ensuring participation conditions are explicit and limited.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Adaptive controls prevent enforcement of participation beyond approved conditions.

components.title: Withdrawal and Response Revocation
components.description: Supports withdrawal from surveys and handling of responses upon participant request where applicable.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Improper retention of responses after withdrawal or revocation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle management to enforce withdrawal and revocation where possible.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Survey responses are managed according to withdrawal and disposition requirements.

components.title: Ethics Review and Oversight Alignment
components.description: Aligns survey activity with institutional ethics review and oversight processes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Circumvention of institutional oversight or approval processes.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit and review mechanisms supporting governance accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies require ethics review and approval for survey activities.
Audit review supports verification of ethics compliance.
